verdict.rationale: Salv documents an API to fetch person risk factors and a webhook that fires when a person's risk level changes. Together these support basic inspection of a customer's risk factors and notification of risk changes. Nothing in the evidence shows a compliance officer configuring risk factors or weights, or an explanation or history of why a score changed. Missing for 10: documented risk-factor configuration (UI or API), a risk-score change history or explanation view, a risk-scoring model description, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can configure customer risk factors and inspect why the risk score changed

citations.quote: Configuring a webhook will cause Salv to notify client application about a particular event, for example about a creation of a new alert or change of a risk level for any person.
